name: PrestaShop
label: PrestaShop Webservice — resource CRUD (JSON output)
description: PrestaShop Webservice. HTTP Basic with api_key as username and empty password (auth.basicKeyPosition=username). Writes are XML. output_format=JSON on reads. Shop-wide key — scope it in PrestaShop. Docs: https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/tutorials/testing-access/
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: resource_list | resource_get | resource_create | resource_update | resource_delete. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Resource id for get/update/delete path {id} when that operation needs it.

schema.label: resource
schema.description: URL path parameter `resource` for operations: resource_list, resource_get, resource_create, resource_update, resource_delete. Required by: resource_list, resource_get, resource_create, resource_update, resource_delete.

schema.label: output_format
schema.description: Query-string parameter `output_format` for operations: resource_list, resource_get.

schema.label: xml
schema.description: resource_create / resource_update raw XML body (PrestaShop Webservice writes are XML). Example: <?xml version="1.0"?><prestashop><customer><firstname>Ada</firstname></customer></prestashop>.

schema.label: date
schema.description: resource_list. true enables date filters. Example: true.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: resource_list | resource_get | resource_create | resource_update | resource_delete. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: PrestaShop webservice key. HTTP Basic username with empty password (auth.basicKeyPosition=username). Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
